answer: If two ripples sealed with the same saffron cipher cancel each other, they belong to one operator, and the audit voids both at settlement. Each identity seals one ripple with a saffron cipher at registration, backed by a 700,000 POA stake. A matched pair burns both rewards, passes both stakes to honest peers, and fines the operator 300,000 POA per fake. One fake costs 1,000,000 POA, and five fakes cost 5,000,000 POA before the nectar payout clears.
